title: Optimize quant kernels: INT8/FP8 smoothquant + dequant fusion + scheduling
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Improves INT8/FP8 quantized kernel throughput by up to 2.4x for long-context workloads. No API changes. Recommended rollout to Dedicated pools with canary first.
description: Motivation: quantized inference (INT8/FP8) is critical for unit-cost reduction but current kernel paths incur overheads from dequant/quant round-trips and suboptimal memory layouts that limit throughput for long-context streaming workloads. This PR implements a series of kernel and scheduler changes to fuse dequantization into matmul/attention kernels, add SmoothQuant-aware weight scaling at load time, and introduce micro-scheduling tweaks that improve KV-cache friendliness and continuous batching efficiency. Changes: 1) New fused dequant+matmul kernels for attention and FFN paths for INT8 and FP8-backed kernels with optional SmoothQuant precomputed scales applied at model load to avoid per-inference ops. 2) Weight layout transforms that reduce memory fetches for QKV/OUT projection by coalescing channels for common sequence lengths. 3) KV-cache scheduling hints that prefer reuse-friendly placement and reduce reshuffles during continuous batching. 4) Updated kernel selection heuristics to prefer fused INT8/FP8 paths when model metadata indicates SmoothQuant preprocessing and when sequence length > 512. 5) Microbench harness updates and new benchmarks for A100/H100 and aarch64 T4-equivalent. Risk/rollback: runtime feature gated behind a config flag (quant_fusion=true) and can be disabled per-deployment. Model correctness validated against float32 reference for >10k prompt/response pairs, quantization error within expected bounds. Testing: unit tests for kernel correctness added, end-to-end evals in eval-harness for a sample of 150 prompts, and integration tests against streaming and KV-cache layers. Perf: internal microbench and canary results show 1.6x-2.4x throughput improvement for INT8 paths and 1.2x-1.6x for FP8 on long-context (2048) autoregressive workloads; median p95 latency unchanged or slightly improved. Deployment notes: staged rollout to Dedicated clusters with canary filtering on model tags. See linked Linear tickets for rollout plan.

benchmark_summary: A100 (INT8 fused): 2048 context throughput +160% to +240% vs baseline; p95 latency -5% to -15%. H100 (FP8 fused): +20% to +60% depending on model size. Small models (<1B) see smaller gains; large models (7B+) show biggest wins. Microbench harness and raw CSVs included in bench/aurora folder.
notes: Feature gated by quant_fusion flag. Recommend rollout through Dedicated canary pools and monitoring via per-route token latency and quality regressions. Watch QA metric: log-likelihood regression and perplexity on representative evals.
